item.title: The Wine Barrel Paint & Sip: Pottery Night
item.description: The Wine Barrel Paint & Sip: Pottery Night Join The Wine Barrel on Friday 25 September from 7-9pm for a guided pottery-painting evening with local ceramicist Natasha Jackson (Natasha Jackson Ceramics). Guests choose a mug, bowl or plate and paint it their way - first drink included. Tickets are £35 per person. \n
